comments.author: Longjumping-Cook-842
comments.body:
I wasn’t able to work anything worthwhile intraday just due to friction. I have a few that were positive but only 4-8 bps mean so unless I was trading massive size it just wasn’t worth it. 

I ended up with two swing setups that worked one is live and one will probably be live in 2-4 weeks, working on getting kde levels consistently calculated automatically. 

From all of the strategies I’ve tested and the angles I’ve taken I’d be surprised. Primarily because algo trading is data based and is more about positive expectancy based on data rather than maintaining a specific r/r. 

One of the swing setups I run has a 2% price target, a 4% stop on open, and an atr based trailing stop after being up 1%. So technically that wouldn’t fit prop firm atr. 

My other swing setup has no stop at all just a concurrent trade cap and a setup wide max loss killswitch to manage risk. 

This is just me though and I can’t say for others.
